title: Zoom the PCB view to the board extents
summary: Reads the current board's BoundingRectangle and zooms the PCB editor onto it with GraphicalView_ZoomOnRect, reporting the viewport before and after; the rectangle covers all objects, not only the outline.
phrasings: fit the whole board in the view
zoom the PCB editor to a rectangle
get the bounding box of a board
read the visible area of the PCB view

commands.name: ZoomToBoardExtents
commands.description: Zoom the PCB view to the board's bounding rectangle
